FORTISBC ENERGY INC.
For the Year Ended December 31, 2023
The Corporation is serving approximately 1,080,000 residential, commercial, industrial, and transportation customers.
In September 2023, the BCUC issued its decision. The BCUC determined that FEI's deemed equity component of total capital structure and allowed ROE will change from 38.5 per cent and 8.75 per cent to 45 per cent and 9.65 per cent, respectively, effective January 1, 2023.
